verdict.rationale: The evidence documents async one-off jobs (run_job returns a job ID), a batch queue, multi-step Pipelines deployable as a Pipeline ID, and a CLI usable in scripts or CI/CD. None of these is a recurring schedule: each is a one-off invocation, and scheduling via external cron or CI would be a user-side workaround. Scheduling is a fair axis for a document-processing platform, so the lack of a documented scheduler means none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
